author: New China TV
description:
A lively Egyptian-Chinese cultural performance was held in Cairo on Monday to mark this year's United Nations Chinese Language Day.
   The event took place at the British University in Egypt and was attended by about 100 guests. Egyptian and Chinese students performed a mix of music and dance, combining traditional, classical, modern, and martial arts styles.
title: Egyptian-Chinese art performance marks UN Chinese Language Day in Cairo

description: China's industrial economy posted steady growth in the first quarter (Q1) of 2026, with technological innovations unleashing more growth potentials and the advanced manufacturing sector witnessing accelerated growth, according to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Tech advancements underpin China's Q1 industrial economy

description: Join Sherry Zhu, a Chinese-American creator, as she immerses herself in Guangxi's Sanyuesan Festival. Savoring a bowl of Laoyoufen, a cherished local delicacy, she discovers how this flavorful dish transcends cultures, fostering a warm sense of friendship and connection.
title: Savoring Sanyuesan: Sherry Zhu's first experience with laoyou rice noodles

title: Keywords on China from Russian Navy seamen

author: New China TV
description: Want to try Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu without the "luxury gym" price tag? This Shanghai night school offers a 12-session intro for just 500 yuan (73 U.S. dollars). It's winning over expats with its welcoming vibe and solid coaching. Come for the sport, stay for the community!
title: Expats learn Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu at Shanghai night school

title: 250kg pumpkin, sweet fruit eggplants showcased at Shouguang Int'l Vegetable Expo

author: New China TV
description: Join Xinhua to explore an unmanned farm in Qingfeng County, central China's Henan, where spring ploughing is fully digital: drones, sensors, and driverless machines, guided by the BeiDou system, boost efficiency, precision, and yields from sky to soil. (recorded)
title: LIVE: How technology empowers spring ploughing in central China's Henan

author: New China TV
description: How can an ancient academy meet modern needs? In 2025, the centuries-old Yuzhang Academy was reborn in Nanchang, east China's Jiangxi Province, not as a museum or hotel, but as a real library for genuine reading. Wang Yangming, a Chinese philosopher and educator of Ming Dynasty (1368-1644), once lectured here on "the unity of knowledge and action." The philosophy of "Zhi Xing He Yi," or "unity of knowledge and action" continues to inspire us today.
title: Academy Answers | How an ancient academy meets modern needs

author: New China TV
description: China's railway workers are now zapping trouble from afar. The device locks onto kites, plastic bags, or balloons tangled in overhead power lines and burns them clean with a precision high-heat beam. Safer, faster, and straight out of sci-fi. #HighSpeedRailway #ChinaTech #laser
title: Chinese railway workers use laser device to remove waste from high-speed power lines

author: New China TV
description: Shanghai's first rail transit project crossing the Yangtze River has achieved full track completion. The 42-kilometer Chongming Line will connect Pudong with Chongming Island, improving regional travel and accessibility. The line is expected to open later this year.
title: Shanghai completes first metro line beneath the Yangtze River

author: New China TV

title: Yellow River's Hukou Waterfall presents stunning, clear cascades

description:

An international surgery training attended by surgeons from 11 Belt and Road Initiative partner countries was held in China's Chengdu to help advance minimally invasive technology. #robotics
title: China's Chengdu hosts int'l surgery training to advance minimally invasive technology

author: New China TV
description: A Zimbabwean merchant using crutches walked normally at the 139th Canton Fair -- thanks to a wearable exoskeleton. He bought it on the spot and now aims to bring the technology to Africa. Innovation meets opportunity. #CantonFair #exoskeleton #robotics
title: Wearable exoskeleton helps Zimbabwean merchant walk at Canton Fair

author: New China TV
description: The Japanese government officially revised "the three principles on transfer of defense equipment and technology" and their implementation guidelines on Tuesday to enable overseas sales of weapons, including those with lethal capabilities. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Japan officially eases arms export rules

description: The remains of 12 Chinese People's Volunteers martyrs who lost their lives in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea (1950-1953) will be returned to China from the Republic of Korea (ROK) on Wednesday, according to China's Ministry of Veterans Affairs. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | New batch of Chinese martyrs' remains from Korean War to be returned Wednesday

author: New China TV
description: Circular green fields are emerging on the southern edge of the Taklimakan Desert in northwest China's Xinjiang, where 8,000 mu (about 533 hectares) of winter wheat in Kunyu City has entered the jointing stage. Check out the 380-metre centre-pivot sprinkler system that has made this possible!
title: Circular green fields emerge on desert edge in NW China's Xinjiang

author: New China TV
description: Weifang in east China’s Shandong Province, known as the “World Capital of Kites,” hosts its annual International Kite Festival as spring arrives. Kite flyers from around the world gather to showcase creative designs and share the joy of this traditional Chinese pastime. Which kite do you like most? (recorded)
title: LIVE: Spring takes flight in Weifang as global kites paint the sky
